cell_kind: Stage-3 determinism probe (owner decision 140): the locked v2.0 plan, byte-identical, flown twice in one chain on a single-slot, prompt-cache-off serving geometry; DESCRIPTIVE, yields the per-row byte-identity count and the geometry's throughput.
claim_boundary: No superiority, generalisation, component-causal, bar, admission, held-out, confirmatory or paper-scale claim of any kind. A byte-identity count measures the instrument, not an effect; 50 of 50 would not make a 200-row floor, and fewer would not make a defect.
decision: Cell DET is admitted as a cheap test: the locked plan on one 24,576-token slot with the prompt cache off, pass A then pass B, on the first 50 rows of TRAIN Fold A; the read is DESCRIPTIVE and yields the per-row byte-identity count of the delivered answer between the passes and the geometry's contacts per minute and prompt tokens per second beside ROLL-2's. It decides a determinism question and informs a throughput one; adoption of any geometry is decided on throughput.
failure_policy: Stop and preserve on the first failure. AT MOST ONE root-diagnosed recovery re-registration per pass; a second failure closes the pass and the fix is proven on a four-row dry run. A resident-session identity refusal spends no contact and is not a flight failure. A pass that seals alone answers nothing: the read needs both.
